zh:
# Coolify **用于将应用、数据库和服务部署到自己服务器的开源平台。** 永久开源免费，遵循我们的[理念](https://coolify.io/philosophy). ![Latest Release Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/dynamic/json?labelColor=grey&color=6366f1&label=Latest%20released%20version&url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.coollabs.io%2Fcoolify%2Fversions.json&query=stable.coolify.version&style=for-the-badge ) [官网](https://coolify.io) · [文档](https://coolify.io/docs) · [Cloud](https://app.coolify.io) · [Discord](https://coollabs.io/discord) · [社区](https://github.com/coollabsio/coolify/discussions)
## Coolify 是什么？ Coolify 是 Heroku、Netlify 和 Vercel 的开源、自托管替代方案。它帮助你在自己的硬件上管理服务器、应用和数据库，只需 SSH 连接。 你可以使用 VPS、裸机服务器、树莓派或其他接受 SSH 连接的服务器。Coolify 提供云平台的便利，同时让你保有对基础设施的控制。 配置保留在你的服务器上。即使停止使用 Coolify，正在运行的资源仍会继续工作并可继续管理。 ## Coolify 能做什么？ - **部署应用：** 从 GitHub、GitLab、Bitbucket 或 Gitea 获取代码，使用 Nixpacks、Railpack、Dockerfile、Docker Compose 或预构建 Docker 镜像进行构建。 - **运行数据库和服务：** 部署带持久存储及生成凭据的托管数据库和 360 多种一键服务。 - **自动部署：** 每次 Git 推送时部署、创建 Pull Request 预览、调用部署 webhook，并回滚到保留的应用镜像。 - **管理网络：** 配置自定义域名、自动 HTTPS 证书、反向代理、健康检查和容器网络。 - **运维基础设施：** 管理多台服务器、检查部署和运行日志、打开容器终端并监控资源状态。 - **保护工作负载：** 配置数据库与存储备份、计划任务、环境变量、密钥和通知。 - **集成工作流：** 通过仪表盘、API、CLI、MCP 和基于团队的访问控制管理资源。 ## 快速开始 在受支持的服务器上使用一条命令安装 Coolify： ```bash curl -fsSL https://cdn.coollabs.io/coolify/install.sh | bash ``` 有关要求和详细说明，请阅读[安装指南](https://coolify.io/docs/installation)。运行前也可以审阅[安装脚本](https://github.com/coollabsio/coolify/blob/82d89589a2b29233d2eb3ec47dc2b2ed4289bc9e/scripts/install.sh)。 ## 自托管或云服务 | 自托管 | Coolify Cloud | | --- | --- | | 在自己的服务器上安装 Coolify。 | 使用由我们维护的 Coolify 实例。 | | 控制并维护完整平台。 | 获得高可用性并减少维护工作。 | | 免费且开源。 | 提供邮件通知及额外支持的付费服务。 | 推荐的自托管配置是使用一台服务器运行 Coolify，并使用一台或多台服务器运行部署的资源。如果不想维护 Coolify 服务器，可使用 [Coolify Cloud](https://app.coolify.io)。当前价格请查看 [coolify.io](https://coolify.io)。 ## 社区与支持 - 阅读[文档](https://coolify.io/docs)。 - 在 [Discord](https://coollabs.io/discord) 加入社区。 - 在 [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/coollabsio/coolify/discussions) 提问。 - 提交更改前请阅读[贡献指南](https://github.com/coollabsio/coolify/blob/82d89589a2b29233d2eb3ec47dc2b2ed4289bc9e/CONTRIBUTING.md)。 - 查阅[行为准则](https://github.com/coollabsio/coolify/blob/82d89589a2b29233d2eb3ec47dc2b2ed4289bc9e/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md). - 通过[支持页面](https://coolify.io/docs/contact)联系团队。 ## 捐赠 为了保持完全免费与开源、不将功能置于付费墙后并持续发展项目，我们需要你的帮助。如果你喜欢 Coolify，请考虑捐赠，支持项目未来的开发。 [coolify.io/sponsorships](https://coolify.io/sponsorships) 非常感谢！ ### 大额赞助商 * [Ginernet](https://ginernet.com/) - # Coolify **An open-source platform to deploy applications, databases, and services on your own servers.** Open source & free forever, backed by our [philosophy](https://coolify.io/philosophy). ![Latest Release Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/dynamic/json?labelColor=grey&color=6366f1&label=Latest%20released%20version&url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.coollabs.io%2Fcoolify%2Fversions.json&query=stable.coolify.version&style=for-the-badge ) [Website](https://coolify.io) · [Documentation](https://coolify.io/docs) · [Cloud](https://app.coolify.io) · [Discord](https://coollabs.io/discord) · [Community](https://github.com/coollabsio/coolify/discussions)
## What is Coolify? Coolify is an open-source and self-hostable alternative to Heroku, Netlify, and Vercel. It helps you manage servers, applications, and databases on your own hardware. You only need an SSH connection. You can use a VPS, a bare-metal server, a Raspberry Pi, or any other server that accepts SSH connections. Coolify gives you the convenience of a cloud platform while you keep control of your infrastructure. Your configurations stay on your servers. If you stop using Coolify, your running resources continue to work and remain manageable. ## What can Coolify do? - **Deploy any application:** Build from GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, or Gitea with Nixpacks, Railpack, Dockerfile, Docker Compose, or a prebuilt Docker image. - **Run databases and services:** Deploy managed databases and more than 360 one-click services with persistent storage and generated credentials. - **Automate deployments:** Deploy on every Git push, create pull-request previews, call deployment webhooks, and roll back to retained application images. - **Manage networking:** Configure custom domains, automatic HTTPS certificates, reverse proxies, health checks, and container networks. - **Operate your infrastructure:** Manage multiple servers, inspect deployment and runtime logs, open container terminals, and monitor resource status. - **Protect your workloads:** Configure database and storage backups, scheduled tasks, environment variables, secrets, and notifications. - **Integrate with your workflow:** Manage resources through the dashboard, API, CLI, MCP, and team-based access controls. ## Quick start Install Coolify on a supported server with one command: ```bash curl -fsSL https://cdn.coollabs.io/coolify/install.sh | bash ``` Read the [installation guide](https://coolify.io/docs/installation) for requirements and detailed instructions. You can also review the [installation script](https://github.com/coollabsio/coolify/blob/82d89589a2b29233d2eb3ec47dc2b2ed4289bc9e/scripts/install.sh) before you run it. ## Self-hosted or Cloud | Self-hosted | Coolify Cloud | | --- | --- | | Install Coolify on your own server. | Use a Coolify instance that we maintain. | | Control and maintain the complete platform. | Get high availability and less maintenance. | | Free and open source. | Paid service with email notifications and additional support. | The recommended self-hosted setup uses one server for Coolify and one or more servers for deployed resources. If you do not want to maintain the Coolify server, use [Coolify Cloud](https://app.coolify.io). See [coolify.io](https://coolify.io) for current pricing. ## Community and support - Read the [documentation](https://coolify.io/docs). - Join the community on [Discord](https://coollabs.io/discord). - Ask questions in [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/coollabsio/coolify/discussions). - Read the [contribution guide](https://github.com/coollabsio/coolify/blob/82d89589a2b29233d2eb3ec47dc2b2ed4289bc9e/CONTRIBUTING.md) before you submit a change. - Review the [code of conduct](https://github.com/coollabsio/coolify/blob/82d89589a2b29233d2eb3ec47dc2b2ed4289bc9e/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md). - Contact the team through the [support page](https://coolify.io/docs/contact). ## Donations To stay completely free and open-source, with no feature behind the paywall and evolve the project, we need your help. If you like Coolify, please consider donating to help us fund the project's future development. [coolify.io/sponsorships](https://coolify.io/sponsorships) Thank you so much! ### Huge Sponsors * [Ginernet](https://ginernet.com/) - Hosting powerful servers in Spain * [SerpAPI](https://serpapi.com) - Google Search API — Scrape Google and other search engines from our fast, easy, and complete API. * [MVPS](https://www.mvps.net) - Cheap VPS servers at the highest possible quality * [ScreenshotOne](https://screenshotone.com) - Screenshot API for devs * [PrivateAlps](https://privatealps.net) - Cloud Services Provider, VPS, servers infrastructure for people who care about privacy and control * [Seibert Group](https://seibert.link/coolifysoftware) - Boost productivity company-wide with AI agents like Claude Code * [Contabo](https://contabo.com/en/coolify-vps/) - Cloud VPS & dedicated servers at unbeatable prices ### Big Sponsors * [Vanaways](https://www.vanaways.co.uk) - New vans for sale and lease across the UK * [Cloudways](https://www.cloudways.com/en/?id=2125302) - Managed cloud hosting platform by DigitalOcean * [ByteBase](https://www.bytebase.com) - Database CI/CD and Security at Scale * [Ramnode](https://ramnode.com/) - High Performance Cloud VPS Hosting * [23M](https://23m.com) - Your experts for high-availability hosting solutions! * [Macarne](https://macarne.com) - Best IP Transit & Carrier Ethernet Solutions for Simplified Network Connectivity * [Hetzner](http://htznr.li/CoolifyXHetzner) - Server, cloud, hosting, and data center solutions * [Logto](https://logto.io) - The better identity infrastructure for developers * [Supadata](https://supadata.ai/) - Scrape YouTube, web, and files.
